input.command:
cd /home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0514_1/projects/struct_self_consist_ie/docs/paper && \
# Get all labels from appendix
labels=$(grep -oP '\\label\{([^}]+)\}' sections/appendix.tex | sed 's/\\label{//;s/}//') && \
# For each label, search for \ref{label} or \cref{label} or \autoref{label} or \hyperref[label] in ALL tex files except appendix
echo "=== CHECKING EACH APPENDIX LABEL ===" && \
for label in $labels; do
  # Search in non-appendix files
  main_refs=$(grep -rl "\\\\\\(c\\|auto\\|\\)ref{$label}" sections/*.tex main.tex 2>/dev/null | grep -v appendix.tex || true)
  # Search in appendix itself
  app_refs=$(grep -c "\\\\\\(c\\|auto\\|\\)ref{$label}" sections/appendix.tex 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
  # Also check \hyperref
  main_hyper=$(grep -rl "\\\\hyperref\[$label\]" sections/*.tex main.tex 2>/dev/null | grep -v appendix.tex || true)
  app_hyper=$(grep -c "\\\\hyperref\[$label\]" sections/appendix.tex 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
  
  if [ -z "$main_refs" ] && [ -z "$main_hyper" ]; then
    if [ "$app_refs" -gt 0 ] || [ "$app_hyper" -gt 0 ]; then
      echo "SELF-ONLY: $label (appendix-internal refs: $((app_refs + app_hyper)))"
    else
      echo "ORPHAN: $label (no refs anywhere)"
    fi
  fi
done

input.command:
cd /home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0514_1/projects/struct_self_consist_ie/docs/paper && \
# Get all labels defined in appendix.tex
all_app_labels=$(grep -oP '\\label\{([^}]+)\}' sections/appendix.tex | sed 's/\\label{//;s/}//' | sort -u) && \
# Get all refs from non-appendix files that look like they point to appendix (app: prefix, or sec:mechanistic etc)
echo "=== BROKEN REFS (ref to non-existent appendix labels) ===" && \
# Find all \ref{app:...} or \ref{tab:...} etc in main text files
for f in sections/*.tex main.tex; do
  [ "$f" = "sections/appendix.tex" ] && continue
  # Extract all referenced labels
  refs=$(grep -oP '(?:c|auto)?ref\{([^}]+)\}' "$f" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/.*ref{//;s/}//' | sort -u)
  for ref in $refs; do
    # Check if this ref targets something in appendix (starts with app: or is a known appendix pattern)
    # We check if the label exists in ANY tex file
    exists=$(grep -rl "\\\\label{$ref}" sections/*.tex main.tex 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ -z "$exists" ]; then
      echo "BROKEN: \\ref{$ref} in $f -> label not found anywhere"
    fi
  done
done
